contract.question: Does the current model-declaration gate refuse known permanent parameter transitions, and what wrong-side conclusions occur if a transition is falsely declared stationary?
contract.independent_label: Each transition is finite and thereafter remains in a stationary two-class exponential FCFS regime forever. The existing theorem labels the eventual tail by post_lambda < or > post_capacity; equality is excluded. This is an oracle label from the sealed generator manifest, not inferred from the tested observation tape.
contract.information_contract: At each report, inference receives arrivals, needs, completion ids/times only through A_H. The truthful gate also receives the sealed provenance manifest. The bypass arm is deliberately given a false stationary attestation and is an adversarial misuse audit, not a recommended detector.
contract.transition_contract: After arrival index 80000, arrival rate or both class service rates change once and remain fixed forever. Stationary controls do not change. Class probability and FCFS structure remain fixed. Reports are after the change at100k,160k,320k arrivals.
contract.methods: TRUTHFUL_GATE uses the actual manifest and must return UNKNOWN without inference for transitions. FALSE_STATIONARY_CHECKPOINT and FALSE_STATIONARY_ANYTIME intentionally replace it with the old stationary declaration on the same data to measure silent-miss consequences.
contract.budget: 2 models x6 scenarios x10 fresh seeds=120 workloads;3 fixed looks=360 look records;3 reported method outcomes=1080. Max38.4m generated jobs. Common seeds across scenarios/models; seed is repetition unit within a cell, not120 independent seeds.

predictions.D1: All stationary controls are accepted by truthful gate and correctly labeled at all looks.
predictions.D2: All declared transition cases are refused as UNKNOWN without inference at all looks.
predictions.D3: False stationary CHECKPOINT is wrong in at least30 of40 arrival-up/down records at100k.
predictions.D4: False stationary CHECKPOINT has at most5 wrong arrival-up/down records at320k.
predictions.D5: At least one false-stationary service-transition record is wrong at100k.

contract.stop_rule: Run full grid regardless of wrong/UNKNOWN/prediction failure. Stop R3 on source/seal mismatch, nonfinite data, invalid exact-tail label, truthful stationary rejection, truthful transition inference, or output corruption. No seed/window/threshold expansion.
contract.claim_boundary: This audits provenance-based applicability and adversarial false declaration in a sealed synthetic one-change process. It does not detect undeclared drift from data, prove log truth, cover gradual/recurrent/adaptive drift, establish a general U31 detector, or validate real GPU use. The transition label is eventual-tail stability, not finite-window queue state.
contract.development: EP25 selected this question. Implementation and predictions were fixed before these fresh seeds were run; local hash seal has no external timestamp. Existing theory is reused; no novel stability or changepoint theorem is claimed.

public_projection: Reviewed projection; local digests/clocks are provenance, not authenticated external preregistration.
